correctness.rationale: Exact conditioned Crofton integral, pairwise edge overlap identity, binomial-Gaussian mismatch analysis, integrable overlap kernel and rigorous LLN/dominated-convergence evaluation give the all-dimensional constant. originality.rationale: The known mean of Swan is acknowledged as prior. The new variance constant and typical-to-mean limit were compared against the exact published Crofton expectation, Lonke’s central-only law, the finite-dimensional cube-census abstract, the full current combinatorial slicing paper, and indexed central-section results. No matching statement or implied stronger result was identified, although priority remains provisional.
